attribution_limitations: Lipase for patient 1 is printed as 165 U/L in the case text and as 164 in the Table 1 presentation column; the two printed values are kept as an ambiguity and neither is reconciled.

The text values for beta hydroxybutyrate and glucose match the Table 1 presentation (0 hour) column, but the sentence giving them does not cite Table 1 or state a time point, so they are kept as separate facts and not merged. The anion gap sentence does cite Table 1 and is merged with the 0 hour cell.
The source labels both cases canagliflozin-associated DKA and discusses suspected mechanisms, but does not state that canagliflozin caused DKA in this patient.
